text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. EllisDon Corporation is redeveloping the Mount Sinai Hospital located at 600 University Avenue. The majority of the redevelopment includes interior renovations and minor modifications to the exterior of the building. The site is bounded by a private laneway to the north and south, University Avenue to the east and Murray Street to the west. Construction staging areas for the development will be set up at two separate locations on the east side of Murray Street abutting the site. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the east sidewalk and a portion of the northbound lane at the two construction staging areas for a period of 32 months and 47 months.
